decision: Adopt an operational definition of the cost-center month for the kill rule and decide whether Unbound development counts toward it
options: First DAF-specific cash spend (development excluded) | First DAF-specific cash spend including development | A monthly spend threshold | Owner-declared date
recommendation: First DAF-specific cash spend booked to its own budget with development excluded; record the month when it opens
reversibility: High (definition can be revised before the clock starts)

decision: Choose the shared-infrastructure allocation rule across products and economic entities
recommendation: Usage-based allocation reported beside a revenue-based view; never combine entities without a recorded justification
evidence_needed: Measured usage per product once a second product exists

decision: Gate any further DAF-specific build or spend on a named partner with a non-binding price expression and one candidate customer at or above the break-even size for the chosen review allocation (single sponsor or partner book)
options: Gate now | Build S3 first | Validate only ($0-25k ladder)
recommendation: Gate now; restate the size threshold after P3-DEC-MOD005 (sponsor accounts and partner-book accounts in data/model-outputs/tables/gate-break-even.md); continue only $0-25k validation until the gate is met
evidence_needed: V-6 named partner; V-2 price; sponsor-size evidence (P3-GAP-MOD003)

decision: Decide OD-CDD-02 (automated 180-day renewal) before any licensing commitment
options: Keep M1 human review | Adopt M5 hybrid with sample audit | Defer licensing
recommendation: Decide before G1; licensing economics depend on it

decision: Decide who performs and pays for the human deep review under licensing: the sponsor (sponsor labour in Unbound; Echelon bears monitoring only) or Echelon (as a priced service with matching revenue)
options: Sponsor performs (licensing; r1 sponsor policy; UNB-CDD-CIV-010) | Echelon performs as a priced service | Echelon performs unpriced (structurally loss-making)
recommendation: Sponsor performs; Echelon offers review only as a separately priced service; decide alongside OD-CDD-02
evidence_needed: Partner and sponsor interviews (V-6; V-2); counsel on reliance
